subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers ask the external fork PR author to rebase, or authorize a narrow in-repository replacement for this source-reproducible sanitizer bug?
rationale: The bug boundary is clear, but the only open closing PR is conflicting, outside the target repository, and not maintainer-modifiable, so automation should not open a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace or adopt the fix
options.body: Open or authorize a narrow in-repository replacement, credit the external attempt, and retire the fork path after a viable target PR exists.

options.title: Ask for a rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the external fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it onto current main with maintainer edits enabled if possible.

options.title: Wait without replacement
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open, accepting that the visible recap leak remains unresolved until the fork becomes viable.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt the fix
recommendation.body: Open or authorize a narrow in-repository replacement, credit the external attempt, and retire the fork path after a viable target PR exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest routing candidate from the merged shared sanitizer and UI/TUI display-path history.
